title: Positive work-tape count for the call machine
statement: For every finite-state machine $M$ over the Boolean alphabet and every Boolean parameter $e$, the call machine formed from $M$ with parameter $e$ has a strictly positive number of work tapes.
hypotheses_covered: $M$ is a finite-state machine over Boolean symbols
